responsibility: This file implements the variable side of GCC’s symbol-table/callgraph infrastructure. It manages varpool_node creation, hooks for variable insertion and removal, alias construction, initializer retention or discarding, reachability-based pruning of unreferenced variables, section finalization, and final emission of variable declarations and aliases to assembly or LTO output. It is the central ownership and output layer for global/static variable symbols in the symtab, analogous to cgraph handling for functions.
